desc:
🐾 WELCOME TO PET LEGENDS! 🐾
Hatch pets, smash treasure & become a LEGEND!

👑 Hunt ultra-rare KINGS – each with its own skill & Ultimate!
🔥 KING FEST twice a day – King odds climb up to 16x!
⭐ STARFALL – stars rain from the sky, smash them for loot!
🎟️ LEGEND PASS Season 1 – 80 tiers of rewards!
💀 Team up to destroy giant BOSS CHESTS
🏁 Hourly MOUNT RACES – race for a chance at a King!
🌩️ Wild weather gives your pets rare MUTATIONS
✨ Craft Golden & Rainbow pets, complete your Index & Rebirth
🗺️ Explore 6 areas: Spawn, Forest, Jungle, Desert, Farm & Samurai Island
🏆 Climb the Weekly Legends leaderboard!

🎁 Join the group + favorite = 3 FREE Royal Eggs!
💬 Join our community server – button below the game! ⬇️

👍 Like & favorite for more updates! 🐾
